body_measurements_value_presence_check.name: body_measurements_value_presence_check
body_measurements_value_presence_check.value: "body_measurements"."weight_kg" is not null or "body_measurements"."waist_cm" is not null

body_measurements_plausibility_check.name: body_measurements_plausibility_check
body_measurements_plausibility_check.value: ("body_measurements"."weight_kg" is null or ("body_measurements"."weight_kg" > 0 and "body_measurements"."weight_kg" <= 500)) and ("body_measurements"."waist_cm" is null or ("body_measurements"."waist_cm" > 0 and "body_measurements"."waist_cm" <= 500))

pain_reports_custom_region_check.name: pain_reports_custom_region_check
pain_reports_custom_region_check.value: ("pain_reports"."body_region" = 'other' and nullif(trim("pain_reports"."custom_body_region"), '') is not null) or ("pain_reports"."body_region" <> 'other' and "pain_reports"."custom_body_region" is null)

exercises_user_name_unique.name: exercises_user_name_unique
exercises_user_name_unique.where: "exercises"."user_id" is not null and "exercises"."deleted_at" is null

exercises_ownership_check.name: exercises_ownership_check
exercises_ownership_check.value: ("exercises"."is_system" = true and "exercises"."user_id" is null) or ("exercises"."is_system" = false and "exercises"."user_id" is not null)

workout_sessions_chronology_check.name: workout_sessions_chronology_check
workout_sessions_chronology_check.value: "workout_sessions"."completed_at" is null or "workout_sessions"."started_at" is null or "workout_sessions"."completed_at" >= "workout_sessions"."started_at"
